issue.title: Normalize legacy local-only 202608 plan metadata
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-z2.4 note #3 during epic landing. The plan-archive doctor currently reports 33 local-only canonical plans under 202608 as unrecoverable because committed-plan validation rejects missing tale size. Determine which files are approved plans versus legitimate drafts, add valid metadata only where warranted, archive/publish approved plans through the supported plan-archive path, and leave intentional drafts classified without manufacturing approval history.

task_type_fields.impact: The doctor remains noisy and any genuinely approved plans in this cohort cannot be recovered or published until their metadata and approval status are reconciled.
task_type_fields.repro: Run sase bead doctor on athena; observe 33 local-only canonical findings whose detail includes tale-size-missing.

payload.description: Phase sase-z2.4 proposed this metadata-normalization follow-up after valid archive backfills were intentionally separated from legacy invalid local plans
